question: Can a path-oriented compatibility view of the fixed observed MLE-agent forest recover the canonical one-row-per-observed-edge empirical measure exactly, without exposing prospective truth or changing the predictor estimand?

design_timing.interpretation: This is a prospective implementation and verification contract for a release remedy, not an independent discovery of linearization reweighting.

population.rows: all eligible endpoints in the fixed snapshot blind manifests
population.observed_edge: child to parent only when both endpoint identities occur in the same fixed blind population
population.fragment_root: an endpoint whose declared parent is absent from the fixed blind population
population.fragment_leaf: an endpoint with no observed child in the fixed blind population
population.missing_parent_policy: start an observed fragment; never synthesize or impute the absent node
population.single_node_fragment_policy: retain in node and fragment views; contribute no edge occurrence

canonical_tree_native_view.canonical_edge_weight: one per distinct observed child-parent edge
canonical_tree_native_view.identity_redaction_or_pseudonymization_p: deferred until first-960 closure and release review

path_compatibility_view.path_definition: one ordered observed-fragment root-to-leaf node sequence, including single-node paths
path_compatibility_view.edge_multiplicity: number of path records containing the edge, equivalently descendant observed-fragment leaves below its child
path_compatibility_view.consumer_rule: A path-frequency statistic without inverse-multiplicity weights is a separately labelled compatibility sensitivity and must not be reported as the canonical edge empirical measure.

exact_recovery_invariants: every path occurrence references exactly one canonical observed edge
every canonical observed edge occurs in at least one path
for every edge, occurrence count equals declared edge multiplicity
for every edge, the exact rational sum of occurrence masses equals one
the exact rational total occurrence mass equals the canonical unique-edge count
exact rational task masses equal canonical per-task unique-edge counts
exact rational physical-run masses equal canonical per-run unique-edge counts
exact rational depth masses equal canonical per-depth unique-edge counts
every path is contiguous, acyclic, fragment-bound, task-bound and physical-run-bound
observed sibling groups equal canonical edges grouped by parent
all aggregate counts match the bound upstream linearization receipt
classification_rule: The verified classification requires every population, graph, upstream-binding, path-contiguity, exact-rational-recovery, aggregate-accounting, security and reproducibility gate. Any failed gate maps to TREE_NATIVE_PATH_COMPATIBILITY_GATE_FAIL; no partial recovery may rescue it.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_verified: For this fixed outcome-blind MLE-agent snapshot, a tree-native canonical view can coexist with a root-to-leaf path compatibility view whose preregistered inverse-multiplicity occurrence weights exactly recover the canonical observed-edge empirical measure across edge, task, physical-run and depth accounting.

failure_rule: Fail closed on any snapshot, hash, schema, graph, support, upstream, exact-rational, security, byte-reproducibility or independent-verification mismatch. Do not change the population, path definition, multiplicity rule, occurrence mass or classification order after certificate values are observed.
